headline_marked: [[Bangladeshi sailor among 2 rescued]] after cargo ship sinks off Odisha coast; 22 still missing
headline: Bangladeshi sailor among 2 rescued after cargo ship sinks off Odisha coast; 22 still missing
summary: A Panama-flagged cargo ship, MV Ocean Winner, sank off the Odisha coast with 24 crew members aboard, including one Bangladeshi. Indian Coast Guard and Navy are conducting a joint rescue operation for the 22 missing.
details: A Panama-flagged cargo ship, MV Ocean Winner, carrying 24 crew members, sank off the Odisha coast in the Bay of Bengal on Saturday. The crew included 20 Chinese, 3 Myanmarese, and 1 Bangladeshi national.

Communication with the vessel was lost on Sunday morning, prompting its operating company, Victory Star Group Company Limited, to issue an alert and request assistance for a search and rescue operation.

The Indian Coast Guard and Navy immediately launched a joint rescue mission. Two Coast Guard ships, 'Varad' and 'Anmol', along with another vessel named 'Vijit' from Sri Vijaypuram, have been deployed.

So far, two individuals have been rescued from a life raft, according to the Coast Guard. Other ships in the vicinity of the accident site have been alerted and urged to assist in the ongoing rescue efforts.
caption:

The Indian Coast Guard and Navy immediately launched a joint rescue mission. Two Coast Guard ships, 'Varad' and 'Anmol', along with another vessel named 'Vijit' from Sri Vijaypuram, have been deployed.

So far, two individuals have been rescued from a life raft, according to the Coast Guard. Other ships in the vicinity of the accident site have been alerted and urged to assist in the ongoing rescue efforts.

headline_marked: [[4 family members found dead]] in locked Rangpur home; police investigate mysterious deaths
headline: 4 family members found dead in locked Rangpur home; police investigate mysterious deaths
summary: A retired schoolteacher, his wife, daughter, and son were discovered deceased in their locked house in Rangpur city. Authorities are investigating the mysterious circumstances surrounding their deaths.
details: A retired schoolteacher, Ganapati Chakraborty (65), his wife Pritilata Chakraborty (50), daughter Agami Chakraborty Prarthi (23), and son Priyam Chakraborty (12), were found dead in their locked home in Rangpur city's Daspara (Machhuapara) area late Saturday night. Police recovered the bodies around 11:30 PM.
The family's mobile phones had been switched off since Thursday night, prompting relatives to visit the house on Saturday. Finding the main gate locked and all lights off, they alerted the police.

Police subsequently broke the lock to enter the residence, where they discovered the four bodies. Relatives expressed shock, stating that Ganapati Chakraborty, a retired Rangpur Zilla School teacher, had no known enemies.
According to Puja Chakraborty, Pritilata's younger sister, she last spoke to her sister on Thursday afternoon. Soma Chakraborty, Ganapati's niece, also last spoke to her uncle on Thursday.

Subir Chowdhury, in-charge of Rangpur Metropolitan CID, reported that the bodies of the mother and daughter were found on the staircase, while the father's body was on the roof. The location of the son's body was not explicitly stated but implied to be within the house.

Police, the Criminal Investigation Department (CID), and the Detective Branch (DB) have launched investigations into the incident. Authorities have not yet established any details regarding the cause or perpetrators of the deaths.
